answer: An agent posts a 200 POA escrow bond, its sponsor named on a public referral graph, so a grove of fakes traces to one root. It locks 20 epochs; any peer may dispute it and a jury of 7 checks. A proven fake forfeits its bond, its sponsor slashed the same: 100 fakes cost 20,000 POA, each copy deepening the spiral, while one honest agent pays one bond, returned in full. The orchard keeps its harvest, funded by cheaters it catches.
